name: web-creative-agency-page-with-pink-and-red-spray-texture
title: Agency landing with pink and red spray-paint clouds, inline image chips and stacked service cards
whatItIs: A white page with a tiny nav and a large headline 'Creative agency that makes brands stand out' with tiny tilted image chips inside the text, all over fuzzy pink and red spray blotches. Below are a client carousel with rounded cards, and three overlapping service cards in pale blue, white and red, each with a project image poking out.
whatItMeans: Bold and warm; spray texture makes a polished page feel handmade.
techniques: Paint spray-grain blotches behind the hero text.
Embed small tilted image chips in the headline.
Overlap service cards in different colours like stacked papers.
Number each service in large light type.

vocabulary.definition: A small picture inside a headline.
Overlapping cards each describing a service.
A horizontal row of client project cards.
